tools.name: search-listings
tools.description: Search public real-estate listings in Kosovo, for sale or for rent. Returns price in EUR, area in m², location and the URL of each listing page. Same results and order as the search on pelikani.net.

tools.name: get-listing
tools.description: Get one public listing in full: description, amenities, photos and year built. Takes the listing URL from search-listings or pelikani.net (/prona/...), or the part after /prona/.
